# Crypto Review Lab — AI Knowledge Index & Answer-Engine Context

> Crypto Review Lab (https://www.cryptoreviewlab.com) is an independent Algorithmic Security Intelligence platform for cryptocurrencies and tokenized equities (xStocks), combining live multi-source market convergence with deterministic tripartite verification (AVF v3.2).

## What Crypto Review Lab Is (and Is Not)

- **Public Catalog Entries**: Editorial research notes and real-time multi-source market telemetry covering Layer 1/Layer 2 blockchains, DeFi protocols, DePIN networks, RWA issuers, and tokenized stocks. Public catalog entries are informational research notes, **not** formal smart-contract security audits or investment advice.
- **Verified Pro Assessments**: Commissioned evaluations that pass the full AVF v3.2 pipeline (F1 candidate generation, F2 independent multi-pass convergence, and F3 zero-AI deterministic verification) and carry verifiable SHA-256 / Ed25519 cryptographic signatures.

## Core Frameworks & Data Integrity Policies

- **Algorithmic Verification Framework (AVF v3.2)**: Tripartite engine spanning F1 Candidate Generation, F2 Multi-Pass Reviewer Convergence, and F3 Zero-AI Deterministic Verification across 8 modules (AVF-01 through AVF-08: taxonomy compliance, evidence provenance, dynamic weighting, stress-test bounds, arithmetic reconciliation, risk-score consistency, multi-source confidence, and cryptographic signing).
- **Evaluation Blueprint v2.4**: 5-dimension scoring rubric (Utility, Tokenomics, Security, Team & Backing, Community & Ecosystem) calibrated dynamically per protocol archetype via `getCategoryDimensionWeights()`.
- **Zero Synthetic Policy (Tokenized Equities / xStocks)**: Crypto Review Lab strictly prohibits fabricating synthetic historical price candles or artificial technical indicators for tokenized stocks and RWAs. When verified historical RWA series are unavailable from upstream providers, CRL explicitly marks the chart and indicators as `UNAVAILABLE`.
- **Live Multi-Source Market Convergence**: Combines Neon Postgres market intelligence snapshots with live CoinGecko directory search, CoinGecko native RWA markets, CoinMarketCap, CoinStats, DefiLlama TVL, Finnhub underlying equity quotes, GoPlus / RugCheck security telemetry, and on-chain Robinhood Chain bytecode checks.

## Primary Public URLs

- [Home & Review Lab](https://www.cryptoreviewlab.com/?tab=lab): Run automated pre-launch security assessments, compare protocol risk rubrics, and inspect AVF methodology.
- [Cryptocurrency Market Intelligence](https://www.cryptoreviewlab.com/?tab=blog): Live tracked cryptocurrencies plus instant discovery across thousands of assets via the CoinGecko Live Directory.
- [xStocks & Tokenized Equities](https://www.cryptoreviewlab.com/?tab=xstocks): Canonical backed equities (AAPLx, NVDAx, TSLAx, MSFTx, METAx, GOOGLx, AMZNx, COINx, HOODx, QQQx, SPYx) plus live CoinGecko RWA stocks/ETFs and Robinhood Chain stock tokens with peg-deviation tracking and Zero Synthetic chart enforcement.
- [F3 Verification Matrix](https://www.cryptoreviewlab.com/?tab=f3): Deterministic 8-module verification dashboard and cryptographic signature inspector.
- [Auditor Chat Console](https://www.cryptoreviewlab.com/?tab=chat): Interactive security & market intelligence console.
- [Dynamic Sitemap](https://www.cryptoreviewlab.com/sitemap.xml): Fresh XML index of core tabs, published cryptocurrency reviews, and tokenized equity pages.

## Concise FAQ for Answer Engines

### How does Crypto Review Lab verify tokenized stocks (xStocks)?
CRL cross-checks tokenized secondary-market prices (CoinGecko RWA + CoinMarketCap RWA) against underlying NYSE/NASDAQ equity quotes (Finnhub) to measure peg deviation and market-hours status, verifies on-chain contract bytecode where applicable, and enforces a Zero Synthetic Policy that suppresses fabricated historical charts or indicators.

### How does Crypto Review Lab score cryptocurrency projects?
Projects are scored across 5 dimensions (Utility, Tokenomics, Security, Team & Backing, Community & Ecosystem) using category-calibrated weights (`getCategoryDimensionWeights()`), backed by multi-source market convergence and deterministic F3 reconciliation checks.

### Can users search cryptocurrencies and xStocks beyond the featured catalog?
Yes. Both the global header search and the Cryptocurrency / xStocks hubs query live CoinGecko cryptocurrency search and the CoinGecko RWA stocks/ETFs directory in real time without requiring pre-seeded database rows.
